data.one_liner: Server-side utilities for Sign in with Apple in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to validate Apple identity tokens, exchange authorization codes for refresh tokens, and revoke user authorizations. It supports Android, web, and native Apple platforms.
use_when: You need to implement Sign in with Apple on a Dart backend
You want to validate identity tokens and manage user sessions
You need to revoke Apple authorizations from the server
avoid_when: You only need client-side Sign in with Apple
You are building a Flutter app without a Dart backend
strengths: No external dependencies beyond http and jsonwebtoken
Supports all platforms that can run Dart
Handles token validation and refresh flow
weaknesses: No built-in UI or client integration
Requires manual handling of private keys
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, provide Apple private key as a string, call provided methods
